publicReleaseNotes: Release Larder on current Base with the exact rer 0.2.134 pin. Adds service keys, report sessions, the Base agent door with signed Business decision audit, business settings and people, agent attribution, change events and their vocabulary, and a retired-business state, and deploys the public demo on each published release. Ten database migrations (0020 to 0029) apply on upgrade.
agentUpdateInstructions: Apply migrations 0020 to 0029 in order; the platform applies them on upgrade and none rewrites existing business rows. No runtime configuration changes are required. Keep the exact rer 0.2.134 pin for native installation, export and restore.
